name: Russian Twist

instructions.description: Sit on the floor with knees bent and heels on the floor or lightly lifted if appropriate.
Hold a light medicine ball close to the chest and lengthen through the spine.
Lean back slightly from the hips and rotate the trunk side to side with control.
Return to center and sit upright to finish.

performanceMetrics.notes: Count total side-to-side touches or single-side contacts consistently.
Use a light ball that does not force spinal rounding.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Remove the medicine ball to reduce demand.

commentsNotes: Rotate through the ribs rather than yanking with the arms.
